/*insertMasterCmClSalesTaxsheetUploadingCreation_KEPTARDT*/
INSERT INTO KEPTARDT /* 외상매출_세금계산서 */ ( TAX_BILL_NO , KEP_IRS , SITE , DEPT_CODE , STATUS , ISSUE_DATE , CUSTOMER_NAME , IRS_NO , BUYER_CODE
, TOT_SUPP_PRICE , TOT_TAX_PRICE , TOT_AMT , SUPP_PRICE , TAX_PRICE , AMT
, TAX_TYPE , BILL_TYPE , PRINT_DATE , PRINT_USER_ID , PRINT_CNT , PRINT_AVAIL_CNT , CONFIRM_FLAG , REMARK_DESCRIPTION , REMARK_SPECIFICATION , REMARK_QTY , REMARK_PRICE , ASK_TYPE , ADD_DATE , ADD_TIME , ADD_USER_ID , CHANGE_DATE , CHANGE_TIME , CHANGE_USER_ID , SEND_DATE , SEND_TIME , SEND_USER_ID , IF_SEND_DATE , IF_SEND_TIME , IF_SEND_FLAG , AR_CLOSE_MONTH , AR_CLOSE_REVISION , KEP_IRS_NAME , KEP_CEO_NAME_LOC , KEP_INDUSTRY_TYPE , KEP_BUSINESS_ITEMS , KEP_ADDRESS_LOC , IRS_NAME , CEO_NAME_LOC , INDUSTRY_TYPE , BUSINESS_ITEMS , ADDRESS_LOC ) SELECT MAX(SUB.TAX_BILL_NO) TAX_BILL_NO , MAX(KEP_IRS) , MAX(SUB.SITE) , MAX(DEPT_CODE) , 'C' AS STATUS , #{issue_date} AS ISSUE_DATE , MAX(SUB.IRS_NAME) , MAX(SUB.IRS_NO) , MAX(BUYER)
, TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRDOOD0001','KRDOOS0004'))) AS TOT_SUPP_PRICE , TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRDOOD0001','KRDOOS0004') )*0.1) AS TOT_TAX_PRICE , TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRDOOD0001','KRDOOS0004') )) + TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRDOOD0001','KRDOOS0004') )*0.1) AS TOT_AMT
, TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRISUC0004','KRISUC0005','KRISUC0006') )) AS TOT_SUPP_PRICE , TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRISUC0004','KRISUC0005','KRISUC0006') )*0.1) AS TOT_TAX_PRICE , TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRISUC0004','KRISUC0005','KRISUC0006') )) + TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRISUC0004','KRISUC0005','KRISUC0006') )*0.1) AS TOT_AMT
, TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRCOWA0001','KRCOWA0005','KRCOWA0006') )) AS TOT_SUPP_PRICE , TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRCOWA0001','KRCOWA0005','KRCOWA0006') )*0.1) AS TOT_TAX_PRICE , TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRCOWA0001','KRCOWA0005','KRCOWA0006') )) + TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER IN ('KRCOWA0001','KRCOWA0005','KRCOWA0006') )*0.1) AS TOT_AMT
, TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER = SUB.BUYER)) AS TOT_SUPP_PRICE , TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER = SUB.BUYER )*0.1) AS TOT_TAX_PRICE , TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER = SUB.BUYER )) + TRUNC((SELECT SUM(GR_AMT) FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SEQ = SUB.SEQ AND BUYER = SUB.BUYER )*0.1) AS TOT_AMT
, TRUNC(MAX(AMT)) AS SUPP_PRICE , TRUNC(MAX(AMT)*0.1) AS TAX_PRICE , TRUNC(MAX(AMT)) + TRUNC(MAX(AMT)*0.1) AS AMT
, '11' AS TAX_TYPE , MAX(SUB.BILL_TYPE) AS BILL_TYPE , '' AS PRINT_DATE , '' AS PRINT_USER_ID , 0 AS PRINT_CNT , 1 AS PRINT_AVAIL_CNT , 'N' AS CONFIRM_FLAG , 'MRO품목외' AS REMARK_DESCRIPTION , 'MRO품목외' AS REMARK_SPECIFICATION , 1 AS REMARK_QTY , TRUNC(SUM(AMT)) AS REMARK_PRICE , '02' AS ASK_TYPE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS ADD_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS ADD_TIME , #{st_user_id} AS ADD_USER_ID , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS CHANGE_DATE , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS CHANGE_TIME , #{st_user_id} AS CHANGE_USER_ID , '' AS SEND_DATE , '' AS SEND_TIME , '' AS SEND_USER_ID , '' AS IF_SEND_DATE , '' AS IF_SEND_TIME , '' AS IF_SEND_FLAG , SUBSTR(#{issue_date}, 0, 6) AS AR_CLOSE_MONTH , #{close_revision} AS AR_CLOSE_REVISION , MAX(KIRSN.IRS_NAME) AS KEP_IRS_NAME , MAX(KIRSN.CEO_NAME_LOC) AS KEP_CEO_NAME_LOC , MAX(KIRSN.INDUSTRY_TYPE) AS KEP_INDUSTRY_TYPE , MAX(KIRSN.BUSINESS_ITEMS) AS KEP_BUSINESS_ITEMS , MAX(KIRSN.ADDRESS_LOC) AS KEP_ADDRESS_LOC
, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') AS IRS_NAME , (SELECT CEO_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') AS CEO_NAME_LOC , (SELECT INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') AS INDUSTRY_TYPE , (SELECT BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') AS BUSINESS_ITEMS , (SELECT ADDRESS_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRISUC0005') AS ADDRESS_LOC
, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') AS IRS_NAME , (SELECT CEO_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') AS CEO_NAME_LOC , (SELECT INDUSTRY_TYPE FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') AS INDUSTRY_TYPE , (SELECT BUSINESS_ITEMS FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') AS BUSINESS_ITEMS , (SELECT ADDRESS_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = 'KRCOWA0001') AS ADDRESS_LOC
, MAX(DECODE(IRSN.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.COM_NAME_LOC,IRSN.IRS_NAME)) AS IRS_NAME , MAX(DECODE(IRSN.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.CEO_NAME_LOC,IRSN.CEO_NAME_LOC)) AS CEO_NAME_LOC , MAX(DECODE(IRSN.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.INDUSTRY_TYPE,IRSN.INDUSTRY_TYPE)) AS INDUSTRY_TYPE , MAX(DECODE(IRSN.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.BUSINESS_ITEMS,IRSN.BUSINESS_ITEMS)) AS BUSINESS_ITEMS , MAX(DECODE(IRSN.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.ADDRESS_LOC,IRSN.ADDRESS_LOC)) AS ADDRESS_LOC
FROM ( SELECT TM.TAX_BILL_NO , TM.SEQ SEQ , MAX(TM.KEP_IRS) AS KEP_IRS , MAX(TM.SITE) AS SITE , DEPT_CODE , MIN(DECODE(IR.IRS_NO,NULL,CM.COM_NAME_LOC,IR.IRS_NAME)) AS IRS_NAME , MAX(TM.IRS_NO) AS IRS_NO , MAX(TM.BUYER) AS BUYER , SUM(TM.GR_AMT) AS TOT_AMT , SUM(TM.GR_AMT) AS AMT , MAX(CM.CLOSE_CNT) AS CLOSE_CNT , MAX(CM.BILL_TYPE) AS BILL_TYPE FROM KEPTEXUP TM /* 매출세금계산서 업로드 임시 테이블 */ , ICOMGRDT GR /* 구매사별 입고정보 */ , KEPTIRSN IR /* 구매사 사업자정보 */ , ICOMCMPY CM /* 회원사정보 */ WHERE 1=1 AND TM.BUYER = GR.BUYER(+) AND TM.GR_NO = GR.GR_NO(+) AND TM.GR_SEQ = GR.GR_SEQ(+) AND TM.BUYER = CM.COM_CODE AND TM.SITE = IR.SITE(+) AND TM.IRS_NO = IR.IRS_NO(+) AND TM.BUYER = IR.COM_CODE(+) AND GR.STATUS(+) <> 'D' AND GR.AR_BILL_FLAG(+) = 'N'
AND (TM.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} OR TM.BUYER = 'KRDOOS0004')
AND (TM.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} OR TM.BUYER = 'KRISUC0005' OR TM.BUYER = 'KRISUC0006')
AND (TM.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code} OR TM.BUYER = 'KRCOWA0001' OR TM.BUYER = 'KRCOWA0006' OR TM.BUYER = 'KRCOWA0005')
AND TM.BUYER = #{st_buyer_code}
AND TM.SITE = 'KA' AND GR.GR_DATE BETWEEN SUBSTR(#{issue_date}, 0, 6) || '01' AND #{issue_date} AND ( GR.AR_BILL_FLAG = 'N' OR GR.AR_BILL_FLAG IS NULL OR GR.AR_BILL_FLAG = '' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM KEPTARDT B WHERE TM.TAX_BILL_NO = B.TAX_BILL_NO AND TM.DEPT_CODE = B.DEPT_CODE ) GROUP BY TM.TAX_BILL_NO , TM.SEQ , TM.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY SEQ ) SUB , KEPTIRSN KIRSN /* 구매사 사업자정보 */ , KEPTIRSN IRSN /* 구매사 사업자정보 */ , V_VOC_ICOMCMPY CM WHERE 1=1 AND SUB.KEP_IRS = KIRSN.IRS_NO AND SUB.SITE = KIRSN.SITE AND SUB.IRS_NO = IRSN.IRS_NO(+) AND SUB.SITE = IRSN.SITE(+) AND SUB.BUYER = IRSN.COM_CODE(+) AND SUB.BUYER = CM.COM_CODE AND SUB.SITE = CM.SYS_TYPE GROUP BY BUYER , TAX_BILL_NO , SEQ , DEPT_CODE ORDER BY SEQ

/*insertMasterCmClSalesTaxsheetUploadingCreation_KEPTITEM*/
INSERT INTO KEPTITEM /* 세금계산서 품목정보 */ ( TAX_BILL_NO , ITEM_SEQ , REMARK_DESCRIPTION , REMARK_SPECIFICATION , REMARK_QTY , REMARK_PRICE , SUPP_PRICE , TAX_PRICE , REMARK_DATE ) VALUES ( #{key_order_no} , (SELECT TO_CHAR(NVL(COUNT(TAX_BILL_NO),0)+1,'FM000000') FROM KEPTITEM WHERE TAX_BILL_NO =#{key_order_no}) , 'MRO용품외' , '' , '' , '' , TRUNC(#{key_gr_amt}) , TRUNC(#{key_gr_amt} * 0.1) , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') )

/*updateMasterCmClSalesTaxsheetUploadingCreation_ICOMGRDT*/
UPDATE ICOMGRDT GR /* 구매사별 입고정보 */ SET AR_TAX_BILL_NO = (SELECT TAX_BILL_NO FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE BUYER = GR.BUYER AND GR_NO = GR.GR_NO AND GR_SEQ = GR.GR_SEQ) , AR_CLOSE_DEPT = (SELECT DEPT_CODE FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE BUYER = GR.BUYER AND GR_NO = GR.GR_NO AND GR_SEQ = GR.GR_SEQ) , AR_CLOSE_MONTH = SUBSTR(#{issue_date}, 0, 6) , AR_CLOSE_REVISION = #{close_revision} , AR_BILL_FLAG = 'Y' , CLOSE_USER_ID = DECODE(CLOSE_USER_ID,NULL,#{st_user_id},CLOSE_USER_ID) WHERE 1=1 AND (BUYER , GR_NO, GR_SEQ) IN ( SELECT BUYER, GR_NO, GR_SEQ FROM KEPTEXUP WHERE SITE = 'KA'
AND (BUYER = 'KRDOOD0001' OR BUYER = 'KRDOOS0004')
AND (BUYER = 'KRISUC0004' OR BUYER = 'KRISUC0005' OR BUYER = 'KRISUC0006')
AND (BUYER = 'KRCOWA0001' OR BUYER = 'KRCOWA0005' OR BUYER = 'KRCOWA0006')
AND BUYER = #{st_buyer_code}
AND TAX_BILL_NO IS NOT NULL ) AND AR_BILL_FLAG ='N'
